generic.Defined scope/population: All governance documents flagged superseded or replaced in the governance policy inventory.
generic.In-scope period: Current archiving cycle from the document's replacement date to today.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Superseded tag, effective end date, retention class and archive location must all be set.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of newly archived documents matches count flagged superseded this cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archived PDF and tag change saved with SharePoint version history and end date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any document that fails to archive is logged in the inventory with a reason and owner.
generic.Test population: Every governance document marked superseded in the current inventory refresh.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if 100% of superseded documents are archived and tagged within 5 business days.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate unresolved archiving items to the Governance Analyst then Legal Counsel.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archive is complete when the document is tagged, dated and off the active policy list.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint governance archive library and the master governance inventory.

steps.title: Pull superseded documents from the governance policy inventory
sop: Open the governance policy inventory workbook in SharePoint.
Filter for documents whose status changed to superseded or replaced.
Done when the list of documents to archive for this cycle is confirmed.
verify: Cross-check the filtered list against the latest policy revision log.
Pass when every superseded document this cycle appears on the list.

steps.title: Move the superseded file to the SharePoint archive library
sop: Open the SharePoint governance archive library.
Upload or move the superseded charter or policy PDF into the library.
Apply a 'superseded' tag and enter the effective end date.
Done when the file appears in the archive library with the tag and end date set.
verify: Open the archived file record and confirm the tag and end date are visible.
Pass when the metadata matches the source document's replacement date.

steps.title: Record the archive location and retention class in the master inventory
sop: Open the master governance inventory in SharePoint.
Enter the archive library link and retention class for the document.
Done when the inventory row shows the archive path and retention code.
verify: Click the inventory link and confirm it opens the archived document.
Pass when the retention class matches the records retention schedule.

steps.title: Confirm the document is retrievable but removed from the active list
sop: Search the active governance policy list on the governance portal.
Confirm the superseded document no longer appears as active.
Search the archive library to confirm the document is still retrievable.
Done when the document is absent from the active list and present in the archive.
verify: Attempt to retrieve the archived document by its title.
Pass when the document is retrievable but not listed as active.

steps.title: Log any archiving exception with a remediation owner
sop: Identify any document that failed to move to the archive library.
Log the exception in the inventory with reason and assigned owner.
Done when every exception has a named owner and target date.
verify: Review the exception log for open items past their target date.
Pass when no exception remains without an owner and date.

steps.title: Close out the archiving cycle in the governance inventory
sop: Mark each archived document's row as complete in the inventory.
Notify the Governance Analyst that the cycle is closed.
Done when all rows for the cycle show archived status.
verify: Count archived rows against the original superseded list.
Pass when the counts reconcile with no unexplained gap.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every governance policy and committee charter in the GRC platform's policy inventory.
generic.In-scope period: Current annual review cycle measured against each policy's last review date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy name, last review date, and assigned review owner populated for each item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of policies reviewed matches the total policy count in the GRC inventory.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Annual governance review memo saved to SharePoint with review date and author.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any policy past-due for review logged with cause and remediation owner.
generic.Test population: All policies whose last review date exceeds twelve months.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every governance policy shows a review date within the last 12 months.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate past-due policies to Legal Counsel then General Counsel for prioritization.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Review is complete when findings and recommended revisions are recorded in the memo.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform policy inventory and the annual governance review memo in SharePoint.

steps.title: Pull the current policy inventory from the GRC platform
sop: Open the GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC) governance module.
Export the full policy and charter inventory with last review dates.
Confirm every active policy and charter appears in the export.
Done when the export is loaded for the annual review cycle.
verify: Compare exported row count to the GRC platform's active policy count.
Pass when the counts match with no omitted policy.

steps.title: Confirm each policy has an assigned annual review date
sop: Check the review-date field for every policy in the inventory export.
Flag any policy missing a review date or owner.
Done when every policy row shows a review date and owner.
verify: Spot-check five policy rows against the GRC platform source record.
Pass when the sampled dates and owners match the source.

steps.title: Compare each charter and policy against NAIC CGAD and listing requirements
sop: Open the current NAIC Corporate Governance Annual Disclosure Model Act text.
Compare each policy and charter section against its requirements and listing rules.
Note any gap or outdated reference in the review workpaper.
Done when every policy has been compared against the current requirements.
verify: Re-check two flagged gaps against the model act text.
Pass when the flagged gaps are confirmed genuine discrepancies.

steps.title: Flag policies past-due for review
sop: Calculate the months since each policy's last review date.
Flag any policy whose last review exceeds twelve months as past-due.
Done when the past-due list is finalized for the review memo.
verify: Recalculate the review age for three flagged policies.
Pass when the flagged status matches the recalculated age.

steps.title: Document review findings in the annual governance review memo
sop: Draft the annual governance review memo in SharePoint.
Record findings, gaps against NAIC CGAD, and recommended revisions per policy.
Done when the memo covers every reviewed policy and charter.
verify: Read the memo against the review workpaper flagged items.
Pass when every flagged gap appears with a recommendation in the memo.

steps.title: Route the completed memo for Governance Analyst and Corporate Secretary review
sop: Circulate the draft memo to the Governance Analyst and Corporate Secretary.
Collect comments and confirm findings are accurate.
Done when comments are incorporated into the final memo.
verify: Confirm the final memo version reflects reviewer comments.
Pass when both reviewers confirm the memo is accurate.

steps.title: File the finalized memo and close the review cycle in the GRC platform
sop: Upload the finalized memo to the GRC platform governance workspace.
Update each reviewed policy's status to 'reviewed' with the current date.
Done when the GRC platform reflects the completed review cycle.
verify: Check the GRC platform inventory for updated review dates.
Pass when every reviewed policy shows the current review date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Governance policies and committee charters flagged for revision from the annual review.
generic.In-scope period: Current drafting cycle from review findings through committee submission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Document version number, change summary, and cited requirement populated for each redline.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Number of drafted redlines matches the number of policies flagged for revision.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Redlined draft saved in iManage with incremented version and change log.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any flagged policy not yet drafted logged with reason and target date.
generic.Test population: All policies and charters flagged for revision this review cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every flagged policy has a redlined draft with cited rationale.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate delayed drafts to Legal Counsel for reprioritization.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Draft is acceptable when it cites the driving requirement and updates the version history.
generic.Evidence location: iManage governance document workspace and version history table.

steps.title: Open the standard governance document template in iManage
sop: Open iManage (Legal Docs) and locate the affected charter or policy.
Check out the document using the standard governance document template.
Done when the document is checked out for drafting.
verify: Confirm the checked-out document matches the current published version.
Pass when the baseline text matches the last published version.

steps.title: Draft redlined revisions to the charter or policy
sop: Draft redlined changes addressing the flagged review findings.
Track changes using iManage's redline/compare feature.
Done when all flagged findings are addressed in the redline.
verify: Compare the redline against the review memo's flagged findings.
Pass when every flagged finding has a corresponding redline.

steps.title: Cite the regulatory or listing requirement driving each change
sop: Add a drafting note next to each redlined change.
Cite the specific regulatory or listing requirement driving the change.
Done when every substantive redline has a cited rationale.
verify: Spot-check three redlines for a cited requirement.
Pass when each sampled redline cites a specific requirement.

steps.title: Increment the version number and log the change summary
sop: Open the version history table in the document.
Increment the version number for the new draft.
Log a summary of the changes made in this revision.
Done when the version history reflects the new draft.
verify: Confirm the version number increments sequentially from the prior entry.
Pass when the change summary matches the actual redline content.

steps.title: Route the draft to General Counsel for legal sufficiency review
sop: Send the redlined draft to General Counsel via iManage routing.
Request initial legal sufficiency review before committee submission.
Done when the draft is routed and a review deadline is set.
verify: Confirm the routing log shows General Counsel received the draft.
Pass when a review deadline is recorded in iManage.

steps.title: Incorporate legal sufficiency comments into the draft
sop: Collect General Counsel's legal sufficiency comments.
Incorporate accepted comments into the redlined draft.
Done when all comments are resolved or documented as declined.
verify: Check that every comment thread is marked resolved or declined with reason.
Pass when no comment thread remains open.

generic.Defined scope/population: All governance policy and charter sections subject to NAIC CGAD Model Act #305 requirements.
generic.In-scope period: Current CGAD preparation cycle ahead of the annual disclosure filing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: CGAD element name, document reference, and gap status populated for each requirement.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of CGAD elements reviewed matches the full CGAD requirements checklist count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Gap analysis and sign-off saved to the compliance evidence repository with a date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any missing CGAD disclosure element logged with a remediation owner.
generic.Test population: Every CGAD disclosure element in the current Model Act #305 checklist.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when no open CGAD disclosure-element gap remains against the governance documents.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate unresolved CGAD gaps to Legal Counsel then General Counsel.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Compliance is verified when sign-off is recorded for all represented CGAD elements.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository and the GRC platform CGAD workspace.

steps.title: Load the current NAIC CGAD Model Act #305 requirements checklist
sop: Open the GRC platform (Archer/ServiceNow GRC) CGAD workspace.
Load the current NAIC Corporate Governance Annual Disclosure Model Act (#305) checklist.
Done when the checklist is ready for comparison against governance documents.
verify: Confirm the checklist version matches the current NAIC model act edition.
Pass when the loaded checklist is the most recent version.

steps.title: Compare each governance policy section against the CGAD checklist
sop: Compare each governance policy and charter section against its matching CGAD checklist item.
Mark each checklist item as covered, partially covered, or missing.
Done when every checklist item has a coverage status.
verify: Spot-check five checklist items against the source policy text.
Pass when the recorded coverage status matches the source text.

steps.title: Identify missing CGAD disclosure elements
sop: Review items marked missing or partially covered for board composition, risk oversight, and compensation practices.
Confirm each gap is a genuine absence, not a mislabeled reference.
Done when the confirmed gap list is finalized.
verify: Cross-check two confirmed gaps against the governance document text.
Pass when the gaps are verified as genuinely missing.

steps.title: Update the compliance evidence repository with the gap analysis
sop: Open the compliance evidence repository CGAD workspace.
Upload the gap analysis with each gap's remediation owner and target date.
Done when the gap analysis is filed with owners assigned.
verify: Confirm every logged gap has a named remediation owner.
Pass when no gap is left without an assigned owner.

steps.title: Track remediation of each CGAD gap to closure
sop: Follow up with each remediation owner on gap closure progress.
Update the gap status in the GRC platform as items are resolved.
Done when all gaps show a resolved or in-progress status with notes.
verify: Review the gap log for stale open items past target date.
Pass when no gap remains open past its target date without a note.

steps.title: Confirm sign-off once all CGAD elements are represented
sop: Review the fully updated gap analysis for zero open gaps.
Record Legal Counsel sign-off confirming CGAD compliance.
Done when sign-off is dated and filed in the compliance evidence repository.
verify: Confirm the sign-off record is present and dated in the repository.
Pass when sign-off is recorded with no open gaps remaining.

generic.Defined scope/population: All tracked NAIC model act requirements for governance disclosures assigned for implementation.
generic.In-scope period: Current implementation cycle from requirement assignment to policy publication.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Requirement description, implementation owner, target date, and linked policy populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of requirements marked Implemented matches the count of policy updates published.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: GRC platform requirement record updated with implementation date and policy link.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any requirement missing its target date logged with a revised date and reason.
generic.Test population: Every tracked NAIC model act requirement in the GRC platform.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when each tracked requirement shows status Implemented with a linked policy reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate overdue requirements to Legal Counsel then the Governance Analyst lead.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Requirement is implemented once the policy update is published and linked in the GRC platform.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform requirement tracker and the published policy or charter text.

steps.title: Translate each tracked requirement into a specific policy update
sop: Open the GRC platform tracked NAIC model act requirement list.
Translate each governance disclosure requirement into a specific policy or charter update.
Done when every requirement has a defined update action.
verify: Spot-check three translated actions against the source requirement text.
Pass when the actions clearly satisfy the cited requirement.

steps.title: Assign an implementation owner and target date in the GRC platform
sop: Open each requirement record in the GRC platform.
Assign an implementation owner and target completion date.
Done when every requirement record has an owner and date.
verify: Confirm no requirement record is missing an owner or date.
Pass when all records show a complete owner and date.

steps.title: Update the affected governance policy or charter text
sop: Open the affected policy or charter in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint.
Update the text to satisfy the requirement.
Route the update for Legal Counsel review.
Done when the updated text is approved and ready to publish.
verify: Compare the updated text against the requirement's intent.
Pass when the update fully satisfies the requirement language.

steps.title: Publish the policy update and link it to the requirement
sop: Publish the approved policy or charter update to the governance library.
Link the published document back to the GRC platform requirement record.
Done when the requirement record shows a working policy link.
verify: Open the linked policy from the requirement record.
Pass when the link opens the correct, current policy version.

steps.title: Mark the requirement 'implemented' in the GRC platform
sop: Confirm the linked policy is published and current.
Update the requirement status to Implemented with the completion date.
Done when the status change is saved in the GRC platform.
verify: Filter the requirement list for status Implemented.
Pass when the requirement appears with a completion date and policy link.

steps.title: Review the full requirement tracker for completeness
sop: Review the full tracked requirement list for any item not yet Implemented.
Escalate overdue items for reprioritization.
Done when the tracker reflects current status for every requirement.
verify: Count requirements by status in the GRC platform.
Pass when no requirement is overdue without an escalation note.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every board and committee charter and governance policy currently in force.
generic.In-scope period: Current inventory refresh cycle ahead of board portal publication.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Version, last review date, next-due date, and named owner populated for each item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Inventory row count matches the count of active charters and policies in SharePoint.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Inventory workbook published to SharePoint with a version date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any charter or policy missing an owner logged with a follow-up assignment.
generic.Test population: All active charters and policies listed in the governance SharePoint library.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the inventory lists every active item with owner and next review date populated.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate missing-owner items to the Legal Operations Manager for assignment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Inventory is complete when every item has version, dates, and a named owner.
generic.Evidence location: Governance SharePoint library and the board portal linkage record.

steps.title: List every active charter and policy in the inventory workbook
sop: Open the governance policy inventory workbook in SharePoint.
List every board and committee charter and governance policy currently in force.
Done when every active item appears as a workbook row.
verify: Compare the workbook row count against the SharePoint governance library file count.
Pass when the counts match with no missing item.

steps.title: Record version, last review date, and next-due date per item
sop: For each inventory row, enter the current version number.
Enter the last review date and calculate the next-due review date.
Done when every row shows version and both dates.
verify: Spot-check five rows against the source document properties.
Pass when the sampled versions and dates match the source.

steps.title: Confirm each charter has a named committee owner
sop: Review each charter row for a named committee owner.
Follow up with governance contacts to fill any gap.
Done when every charter row shows a named committee owner.
verify: Filter the workbook for blank owner fields.
Pass when no charter row has a blank owner field.

steps.title: Confirm each policy has a named business owner
sop: Review each policy row for a named business owner.
Follow up with the relevant department to fill any gap.
Done when every policy row shows a named business owner.
verify: Filter the workbook for blank policy owner fields.
Pass when no policy row has a blank owner field.

steps.title: Publish the refreshed inventory to the governance SharePoint library
sop: Save the completed inventory workbook to the governance SharePoint library.
Update the file version and publication date.
Done when the refreshed inventory is saved and accessible.
verify: Open the published file and confirm the version date is current.
Pass when the published version matches the completed workbook.

steps.title: Confirm board portal linkage to the refreshed inventory
sop: Check the board portal's link to the governance inventory file.
Update the link if the file location or name changed.
Done when the board portal link opens the refreshed inventory.
verify: Click the board portal link and confirm it opens the current file.
Pass when the linked file matches the latest published version.

generic.Defined scope/population: The delegation of authority matrix covering all approval tiers and named roles.
generic.In-scope period: Current quarter update cycle triggered by organizational changes.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Role title, approval tier, and dollar or transaction limit populated for each matrix row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Matrix role count reconciles to the current org chart headcount in the HRIS.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Revised matrix published to SharePoint with a version date within the current quarter.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any stale delegation logged with the affected role and correction owner.
generic.Test population: Every approval tier and mapped role in the current delegation of authority matrix.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the matrix reflects current officer titles and limits within the current quarter.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate unresolved stale delegations to the Governance Analyst then Legal Counsel.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Matrix is current when every tier maps to a named, active role with a current version date.
generic.Evidence location: Governance SharePoint library and the GRC platform delegation record.

steps.title: Identify organizational changes affecting approval limits
sop: Review new officer appointments, title changes, and reporting-line moves this cycle.
Determine which changes affect an approval tier in the matrix.
Done when the list of matrix-impacting changes is finalized.
verify: Cross-check the list against the HR change log for the period.
Pass when every relevant HR change appears on the list.

steps.title: Update the delegation of authority matrix for each change
sop: Open the delegation of authority matrix in SharePoint.
Update the named role for each affected approval tier.
Done when every identified change is reflected in the matrix.
verify: Spot-check three updated rows against the HR change log.
Pass when the updated names match the confirmed changes.

steps.title: Confirm each approval tier still maps to a current, named role
sop: Review each approval tier for contract value, dividend, investment, and claim reserve limits.
Confirm the mapped role is currently active and correctly titled.
Done when every tier shows a current, valid role mapping.
verify: Sample five tiers and confirm the named role's current title.
Pass when all sampled roles match their current titles.

steps.title: Reconcile the matrix against the current org chart in the HRIS
sop: Pull the current org chart from the HRIS.
Compare each matrix role against the org chart to catch stale delegations.
Flag any mismatch for correction.
Done when the reconciliation is complete and mismatches are flagged.
verify: Recheck two flagged mismatches against the HRIS org chart.
Pass when the flagged mismatches are confirmed genuine.

steps.title: Publish the revised matrix to the governance SharePoint library
sop: Save the revised matrix to the governance SharePoint library.
Update the version date to reflect the current quarter.
Done when the revised matrix is published with a current version date.
verify: Open the published matrix and confirm the version date.
Pass when the version date falls within the current quarter.

steps.title: Notify affected approvers of the revised matrix
sop: Identify approvers whose tier or limit changed in this revision.
Send a notification confirming the updated matrix and effective date.
Done when all affected approvers have been notified.
verify: Check notification delivery confirmation for each affected approver.
Pass when every affected approver shows a delivered notification.

generic.Defined scope/population: All active governance policies, board charters, and committee terms of reference.
generic.In-scope period: Rolling maintenance window triggered within five business days of Board approval.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Document link, owner, and inventory category populated for every row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Master inventory row count matches the combined policy, charter, and terms-of-reference count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Inventory saved to SharePoint with a version date after each reconciliation.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any unlinked or ownerless row logged with a correction owner and date.
generic.Test population: Every row in the master governance inventory as of the current reconciliation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every active item links to a current document with an owner populated.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate unresolved inventory gaps to the Legal Operations Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Inventory is current when additions and removals are reflected within five business days of approval.
generic.Evidence location: Master governance inventory workbook in the SharePoint governance library.

steps.title: Reconcile the master inventory against the source inventories
sop: Open the master governance inventory workbook in SharePoint.
Compare it against the policy inventory, charter inventory, and terms of reference list.
Done when discrepancies between the sources are identified.
verify: Count rows in each source list against the master inventory.
Pass when the counts reconcile or discrepancies are documented.

steps.title: Add newly adopted policies or charters within five business days
sop: Identify policies or charters newly approved by the Board.
Add each new item to the master inventory within five business days of approval.
Done when all newly approved items appear in the inventory.
verify: Check the approval date against the inventory add date for each new item.
Pass when the add date is within five business days of approval.

steps.title: Remove retired policies or charters from the master inventory
sop: Identify policies or charters retired by Board action.
Remove or archive the retired item from the active master inventory.
Done when retired items no longer appear as active rows.
verify: Search the active inventory for any retired item title.
Pass when no retired item appears in the active list.

steps.title: Verify each inventory row links to the current SharePoint document
sop: Click through each row's document link in the master inventory.
Confirm the link opens the current version of the document.
Done when every row's link is verified working and current.
verify: Spot-check ten links across different inventory categories.
Pass when all sampled links open the correct current document.

steps.title: Confirm the inventory owner field is populated for every row
sop: Review the owner field for each inventory row.
Fill in any blank owner field by contacting the responsible business area.
Done when every row shows a populated owner field.
verify: Filter the inventory for blank owner fields.
Pass when no row shows a blank owner field.

steps.title: Save and version the reconciled master inventory
sop: Save the reconciled and completed master inventory to SharePoint.
Update the version date to reflect the reconciliation date.
Done when the inventory is saved with a current version date.
verify: Open the saved file and confirm the version date is current.
Pass when the version date matches the reconciliation date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All committee members affected by a newly published charter.
generic.In-scope period: Notification window from charter publication through confirmed receipt.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Charter effective date, key changes summary, and recipient list populated in the notification.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Number of notified members matches the current roster of the affected committee.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notification record and delivery confirmation filed in the committee governance folder.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any member without a confirmed open logged with a follow-up reminder sent.
generic.Test population: Every member of the committee whose charter was published this cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when delivery confirmation is recorded for all committee members.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate unconfirmed notifications to the Corporate Secretary for direct follow-up.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notification is complete when every member's read receipt or access log entry is on file.
generic.Evidence location: Committee governance folder and the board portal access log.

steps.title: Confirm the current committee roster before notifying
sop: Pull the current committee roster from the board portal.
Confirm the roster reflects any recent membership changes.
Done when the confirmed roster is used for the notification send list.
verify: Compare the roster against the corporate secretary's committee records.
Pass when the roster matches the official committee membership.

steps.title: Post the newly published charter to the board portal committee library
sop: Open the board portal committee library for the affected committee.
Upload the newly published charter to the library.
Done when the charter is visible in the committee library.
verify: Open the board portal library and confirm the charter file is present.
Pass when the posted charter matches the published version.

steps.title: Send the committee notification email confirming the charter changes
sop: Draft the notification email listing the charter's effective date and key changes.
Send the notification to every current committee member.
Done when the notification is sent to the full committee roster.
verify: Confirm the recipient list matches the current committee roster.
Pass when no current committee member is missing from the send list.

steps.title: Confirm each member's read receipt or portal access log
sop: Check the email read receipts or board portal access log for each recipient.
Follow up with any member who has not opened the charter.
Done when every member's status is confirmed opened or followed up.
verify: Review the access log for outstanding unopened entries.
Pass when every member shows opened or a documented follow-up.

steps.title: File the notification record in the committee governance folder
sop: Save the sent notification and delivery confirmation to the committee governance folder.
Confirm the file includes the recipient list and delivery status.
Done when the notification record is filed.
verify: Open the filed record and confirm the recipient list and status.
Pass when the filed record matches the actual notification sent.

steps.title: Close out any outstanding notification follow-ups
sop: Review any member flagged as not having opened the charter.
Send a direct follow-up reminder and record the response.
Done when every flagged member has a resolved follow-up.
verify: Check the follow-up log for unresolved entries.
Pass when no flagged member remains without a resolved follow-up.

generic.Defined scope/population: Governance policy or charter revisions ready for Board or committee approval this cycle.
generic.In-scope period: Board meeting cycle from packet assembly through the scheduled meeting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Redline, summary of changes, and General Counsel sign-off populated in the packet.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Number of agenda action items matches the number of revisions being presented.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Board packet posted to the board portal with a posting date at least five business days ahead.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any late or incomplete packet item logged with a cause and revised posting plan.
generic.Test population: Every governance revision scheduled for this Board or committee meeting.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the packet is posted at least five business days ahead with an approval action item on the agenda.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate a delayed packet to the Corporate Secretary and General Counsel immediately.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Presentation is complete when the packet is posted, the agenda item is confirmed, and questions are logged.
generic.Evidence location: Board portal meeting materials and the governance approvals folder.

steps.title: Package the redlined revision and sign-off into board meeting materials
sop: Assemble the redlined policy or charter revision, summary of changes, and General Counsel sign-off.
Package these into the standard board meeting materials format.
Done when the packet is assembled and ready for posting.
verify: Confirm the packet includes the redline, summary, and sign-off.
Pass when all three components are present in the packet.

steps.title: Confirm General Counsel sign-off is attached before posting
sop: Review the redlined revision for legal sufficiency.
Provide sign-off confirming the revision is ready for Board presentation.
Done when sign-off is recorded and attached to the packet.
verify: Confirm the sign-off is dated and matches the packaged redline version.
Pass when the sign-off references the correct revision version.

steps.title: Post the package to the board portal five business days ahead
sop: Upload the assembled packet to the board portal meeting materials section.
Confirm the posting date is at least five business days before the meeting.
Done when the packet is posted within the required lead time.
verify: Check the posting timestamp against the meeting date.
Pass when the posting is five or more business days ahead of the meeting.

steps.title: Confirm the agenda includes a discrete approval action item
sop: Review the board meeting agenda for this revision.
Confirm a discrete action item requests Board or committee approval.
Add the action item if it is missing.
Done when the agenda shows the approval action item.
verify: Open the posted agenda and locate the approval action item.
Pass when the action item explicitly references the revision.

steps.title: Record the presenter and any pre-meeting director questions
sop: Identify the presenter for the revision at the meeting.
Log any pre-meeting questions received from directors.
Done when the presenter and questions are recorded for meeting prep.
verify: Confirm each logged question has a prepared response.
